title: Bughunt findings document
description: The structured findings contract for the bughunt suite. Hunters emit this; `bughunt.py merge` validates, fingerprints, dedupes, suppresses, and baselines it; `bughunt.py render` turns it into markdown/HTML/SARIF. The hand-rolled validator in bughunt.py is the executable source of truth; this file is the readable reference.

run.description: Run metadata. Filled by the orchestrator; merge preserves it from the first input that has it.

target.description: Human name of what was hunted

root.description: Absolute path to the hunted repo root

commit.description: HEAD short SHA at hunt time, or null off-git

file.description: Path relative to run.root, forward slashes

id.description: BH-001 style; merge renumbers to keep ids unique across hunters

confidenceLabel.description: Derived by merge when absent: >=0.85 Confirmed, >=0.5 Probable, else Speculative

alsoFlaggedBy.description: Set by merge clustering: the other lenses that independently flagged this same bug. Each entry { lens, title, severity, confidence, line }.

fingerprint.description: Filled by merge when absent: sha256(lens + NUL + relpath + NUL + normalized_snippet)[:16]. Snippet = anchor lines startLine..endLine, whitespace collapsed, string/number literals replaced with §. Stable across line shifts. Fallback when the file/line is unreadable: sha256(lens + NUL + relpath + NUL + title)[:16].

trigger.description: The exact condition/input that fires it

impactClass.description: Drives the triage impact rubric. Defaults to correctness.

repro.description: Failing test / runtime steps / traced values, or 'not reproduced: why'

fixSketch.description: One or two lines; the direction, not a full patch

verified.description: Set by the mandatory adversarial verify phase. merge moves verdict:refuted findings to the refuted appendix and excludes them from the gate.

suppressed.description: Set by merge from .bughunt/suppressions.json; suppressed findings are excluded from the report body and the CI gate
